name: Runemaster Shroudwalker removes the Warpdagger cooldown while Runeshroud is active (#2737)
contract: Shroudwalker 705563 reads 'Your Warpdagger now incurs no cooldown if used while your Runeshroud is active.' and
Runeshroud 500288 adds 'While active, Warpdagger has no cooldown.' when 705563 is known. Its only DBC mechanism is
a -25000 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 on Runeshroud SLS 500510, a separate aura that nothing applies during Runeshroud, so
Warpdagger 500287 kept its full 30000 ms RecoveryTime. Warpdagger has SPELL_ATTR1_ALLOW_WHILE_STEALTHED, so the
cast keeps Runeshroud. Expected: with Shroudwalker and Runeshroud, Warpdagger's cooldown is at most 5 s (the
description says none; the -25000 ms modifier would leave 5 s); a control without Shroudwalker keeps about 30 s.
Fails before the fix (30 s); passes after.

steps.label: SETUP: the control is in Runeshroud
SETUP: the talented Runemaster is in Runeshroud
SETUP: Warpdagger keeps the talented Runemaster in Runeshroud
Without Shroudwalker Warpdagger keeps its 30 s cooldown
CONTRACT: Shroudwalker leaves Warpdagger at most 5 s in Runeshroud
